question: India finished its best-ever performance at World Athletics U20 Championship at Nairobi in August 2021 with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 silver and 1 bronze medal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **U20 World Athletics Championships 2021**

 
 
• The** 2021 World Junior Championships, also known as World Athletics U20 Championships**, were held in the **Moi International Sports Center in Nairobi, Kenya, from August 18 to August 22, 2021**.
 
• The **Under 20 World Athletics Championships** in 2021 in** Nairobi, Kenya**, s**aw an outstanding performance from the Indian athletics team**.
 
• The athletes overcame all **obstacles** to bring home a** total of three medals: two silver and one bronze**.
 
• The medal winners included **17-year-old Shaili Singh, who came in second in the women's long jump** competition by one centimetre.
 
• **Rohtak-native Amit Kumar won silver in the men's 10 km race walk** and **bronze in the 4x400m mixed relay competition **at the U20 Championships in Nairobi.
 
• **Indian athletes** who won medals at the U20 World Athletics Championships in Nairobi in 2021 were **congratulated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• U20 World Athletics Championships

 
 
• Athletes competing in the **under-20 age group of athletics (those who were 19 years old or younger on December 31, of the competition year) compete in the World Athletics U20 Championships**, which are held **every two years**. 
 
• The event was first held as the **1986 IAAF World Junior Championships in Athletics** and **changed** its name to the **IAAF World U20 Championships in November 2015**. 
 
• The current name was adopted with the **name change of the sports governing body in 2019**.
 
• With one **gold and four silver medals in individual and relay sprinting events between 2000 and 2004, Anneisha McLaughlin-Whilby is the most successful athlete** at the championships.
